On October 9, 2026, the entity of Trent D'Ambrosio, assigned by gift for no consideration an aggregate of 19,250,000 shares as follows: (i) 9,500,000 shares to Trent D'Ambrosio individually, (ii) 9,500,000 shares to 4 D Investments LLC, an entity beneficially owned by Lance D'Ambrosio, the brother of Trent D'Ambrosio, (iii) 100,000 shares to Dan Gay, the issuer's COO, and (iv) 150,000 shares to non-affiliates of the issuer. || The amount of securities reported as directly owned by Trent D'Ambrosio includes the 9,500,000 shares assigned by Digital Asset Medium LLC to Mr. D'Ambrosio, as well as 369,328 shares held in Mr. D'Ambrosio's name prior to the assignment, but does not include shares held in other names that are deemed to be beneficially owned by Mr. D'Ambrosio, including 317 shares held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's IRA, 329 shares held as custodian for Mr. D'Ambrosio's son, 100,000 shares held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's son, or 32,609 shares held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's spouse.
